name: Ingridsdottir
saga: They keep the register of what was looked for and not found. It is the smallest output on the board and the least negotiable line on the manifest, because a base that only counts hits quietly stops reporting misses, and the misses are most of the work.

tiers.note: One scribe. One book. Mostly blank, on purpose.
A second book, for the things the first one refused.
Somebody reads back three years and does not repeat a search.
The register is now cheaper than the searching it prevents.
Nine books. Nobody has ever thanked them and the ledger is still the reason.
